SE 499: Project
Description: A software engineering project requiring the student to demonstrate initiative and assume responsibility. The student normally proposes their own project, which must involve substantial engineering science or engineering design. The student must find a faculty supervisor. A project report is required at the end of the term. Plan consent required.
Requirements: Prereq: Level at least 4A Software Engineering
